words.gloss: to those who do not have

literal: Giving and enjoying, to those who do not have, piled up ten million exists even if, nothing.
translation: For those who neither give to others nor enjoy it themselves, even if they possess ten million piled up, it is nothing.
modern: பிறருக்குக் கொடுப்பதும் தான் அனுபவிப்பதும் இல்லாதவர்களுக்கு, பல கோடிகள் சேர்ந்திருந்தாலும் அதனால் ஒரு பயனும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet highlights the true purpose of wealth, which is to be shared with others and enjoyed by oneself. The elongated words 'கொடுப்பதூஉம்' (giving) and 'துய்ப்பதூஉம்' (enjoying) emphasize these two essential actions. If a person lacks the heart to do either, their wealth is entirely useless, even if they have amassed millions.
